meta.name: IEEE 300-bus grid
meta.source: MATPOWER case300.m (https://github.com/MATPOWER/matpower/blob/master/data/case300.m), converted from the public IEEE Common Data Format file in the UW Power Systems Test Case Archive (https://labs.ece.uw.edu/pstca/).
meta.note: Public IEEE test grid (MATPOWER / UW Power Systems Test Case Archive). Every power line is assumed to carry fiber (OPGW), so the communication graph follows the grid. Positions are a computed layout and fiber lengths are scaled so the median line is about 14 km: illustrative, not real distances.
meta.design: Control centers: the two buses with the most lines. Major substations (QKD backbone): generator buses and buses with 3 or more lines. Feeder sub-units (ML-KEM): the rest. QKD only on backbone fibers under 80 km.
